insights.title: Highest MSP Crash Vulnerability
insights.statement: Wheat experiences the highest frequency of wholesale price crashes below MSP.
insights.methodology: Computed across paired record-level modal price and MSP observations where MSP > 0. Denominator excludes records missing modal price or MSP.

insights.title: Warehouse Transit Bottleneck
insights.statement: Transit routes destined for WH-West exhibit the longest average transit times.
insights.methodology: Aggregated from trip-level transit logs. Delay rate uses a data-derived relative benchmark: warehouse-level 75th percentile of transit time.

insights.title: Rainfall vs Arrival Volume Association
insights.statement: Daily rainfall is negatively associated with daily mandi crop arrival volumes in aligned observations (Pearson r = -0.0594). This is a statistical association; it does not establish causation.
insights.methodology: Pearson correlation calculated after aggregating sensor rainfall (mm) and crop arrivals (Qtl) to daily state-wide level, then inner-joining on date. Correlation measures linear statistical association only. Aggregate correlation may also mask district-level differences. Does not establish causation.

insights.title: Top Mandi by Arrival Volume
insights.statement: Tadipatri Mandi (Hisar, Haryana) leads all 57 mandis in total crop arrivals.
insights.methodology: Top mandis are ranked by cumulative arrival quantity in Qtl, summed across all observed crops and dates. All 57 mandis are included in ranking.
